# Siebe Barée

> Siebe is a technical founder based in Limburg, Belgium, looking for someone to start a new company with. He previously founded Enkryptify and built Coinz. This is his personal website at https://siebebaree.com.

## Co-founder search

Siebe's strengths are product and engineering. He would like to meet potential co-founders with experience in sales, marketing or running a business, who share his commitment to building a company. The plan is to get to know each other first and decide what to build together. He is currently building Notchlet.

## Featured work

- [Enkryptify](https://siebebaree.com/work/enkryptify): a secrets management company Siebe founded in 2024, now closed. The team raised $260K in VC funding and had paying customers. The product helped software teams manage API keys and credentials across environments.
- [Coinz](https://siebebaree.com/work/coinz): a Discord economy game Siebe built and ran from 2022 to 2025. It reached 1.35M users and 16K daily active users at its peak. Players could trade stocks, run businesses, hire other players and play more than 15 minigames. Coinz closed in early 2025.

## Other products

- [Notchlet](https://notchlet.com): an open source Mac app Siebe is building that tracks AI coding usage from the notch.
- [Umber](https://umber.s4.nu): an open source image and video studio using your own API keys.
- [anyfmt](https://anyfmt.xyz): an image converter that processes files in the browser, on your device.
- [VoilaZaak](https://voilazaak.be): an experiment in using AI agents to build and sell websites for local businesses.

## Earlier work

- [EEVEE Mobility](https://siebebaree.com/work/eevee-mobility): engineering work on an electric fleet management platform, started in 2024.
- [AquaSolutions](https://siebebaree.com/work/aquasolutions): a Discord bot company and the beginning of Coinz.
- [BotHosted](https://siebebaree.com/work/bothosted): a small hosting business started in 2019.
- [MaxerG](https://siebebaree.com/work/maxerg): a Minecraft server and community started in 2016.
- [Bookmarks](https://siebebaree.com/work/bookmarks): handmade bookmarks sold at school in 2013.

## Meet Siebe

Siebe is going to San Francisco for three weeks in January to find a co-founder. The exact dates are not settled. He will return to Belgium after the trip and wants to move to the US longer term to build a company there. He is open to calls before the trip. He lives in Limburg, Belgium and enjoys the gym and karting.
